triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides clear details, client environment information, expected vs actual behavior, and an explicit API error log ('invalid_grant', 'invalid_rapt') when resuming a session under Vertex AI authentication after re-authenticating.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Resolving this issue requires updating authentication validation and session resumption logic across packages/cli and packages/core to handle stale Vertex AI re-authentication tokens (invalid_grant/invalid_rapt errors) and re-check authentication status.

summary.problem: When a user resumes an existing session after re-authenticating with Vertex AI, the CLI fails with an 'invalid_grant' reauth error ('invalid_rapt') instead of re-verifying/refreshing authentication.
summary.root_cause: When resuming an existing session under Vertex AI authentication, the CLI uses cached authentication state or assumes valid credentials without re-validating the token/credentials or catching reauth-required errors ('invalid_grant' / 'invalid_rapt') to refresh or re-initialize authentication.
summary.context: Google Cloud authentication policies may require periodic Re-authentication Proof Tokens (invalid_rapt). When re-authentication occurs, existing cached tokens or session credentials become invalid and need to be re-fetched via GoogleAuth or re-verified before making API requests.

steps: Update performInitialAuth and refreshAuth to check credential validity when restoring or resuming a session under Vertex AI (AuthType.USE_VERTEX_AI).
Enhance error parsing in packages/core/src/utils/errorParsing.ts to detect invalid_grant and invalid_rapt re-authentication errors.
Ensure session restoration logic in packages/cli/src/core/auth.ts attempts to re-verify or refresh authentication state if credentials are stale or returned an invalid_grant error.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When resuming a session with expired or reauth-required Vertex AI credentials, the CLI catches the invalid_grant error and re-initiates authentication or prompts for re-authentication rather than failing silently with an unhandled API error.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/cli/src/core/auth.test.ts mocking a Vertex AI auth session that encounters an invalid_grant / invalid_rapt API error.
Verify that performInitialAuth or session setup handles the re-auth error appropriately and triggers credential refresh or appropriate user-facing error guidance.
